notes: Needs SCDA Launcher 3.22 (the launcher updates itself at start): on PCs that had the Experimental Build before 2 October, the community skins and game modes were held back as already owned by a Main build add-on; 3.22 installs them. Same game files as x56: the original suits back with the community skins on top, the lobby Skins and Change Mode buttons (Classic, Challenge 25%, Infinite, Blackout 90 s), coop moves and the Club House / Warehouse fixes.
